                (function(klevu) {
                    klevu.extend(true, klevu.search.modules, {
                        addPriceSuffixToQuery: function(data, scope, currencyCode, customerGroupId) {
                            if (typeof data.request.current === "undefined") {
                                return false;
                            }

                            klevu.each(data.request.current.recordQueries, function(key, query) {
                                //code to fetch prices
                                klevu.setObjectPath(data, "localOverrides.query." + query.id + ".settings.priceFieldSuffix", currencyCode + '-' + customerGroupId);
                            });
                        },
                        mageConvertPriceRecordCurrencyData: function(productRecords, currencyCode, currencyRates) {
                            if (!productRecords) {
                                return;
                            }

                            klevu.each(productRecords, function(recordKey, productRecord) {
                                var fromRate = parseFloat(currencyRates[productRecord.currency] || 0);
                                var toRate = parseFloat(currencyRates[currencyCode] || 0);
                                if (!fromRate || !toRate) {
                                    return;
                                }

                                var exchangeRate = toRate / fromRate;

                                if (klevu.isNumeric(klevu.getObjectPath(productRecord, "price"))) {
                                    productRecord.price *= exchangeRate;
                                }
                                if (klevu.isNumeric(klevu.getObjectPath(productRecord, "salePrice"))) {
                                    productRecord.salePrice *= exchangeRate;
                                }
                                if (klevu.isNumeric(klevu.getObjectPath(productRecord, "startPrice"))) {
                                    productRecord.startPrice *= exchangeRate;
                                }

                                productRecord.currency = currencyCode;
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }
                )(klevu);

            <script type="text/javascript" id="klevu_initsessiondata">
                var nowUnixtime = parseInt(Date.now() / 1000);

                function klevufejs_getCookie(name) {
                    if (typeof (name) === "undefined") {

                        name = "klv_mage";
                    }
                    var c = ""
                    , ca = document.cookie.split(';');

                    for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                        c = ca[i];
                        if (typeof c !== "string") {
                            continue;
                        }
                        var cookiePair = c.split("=");

                        if (name === cookiePair[0].trim()) {
                            try {
                                return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookiePair[1]));
                            } catch (err) {// this is fine, data will be regenerated
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return {
                        expire_sections: {}
                    };
                }

                document.addEventListener('klevu.customerData.loaded', function(e) {
                    var klevufejs_cookie = klevufejs_getCookie();
                    klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections.customerData = nowUnixtime + 600;

                    document.cookie = "klv_mage=" + JSON.stringify(klevufejs_cookie) + ";" + (new Date((nowUnixtime + 3600) * 1000).toUTCString()) + ";path=/;SameSite=Strict";
                });

                var klevufejs_cookie = klevufejs_getCookie();
                var klevuData = {
                    ...{
                        customerData: {
                            revalidate_after: -1
                        }
                    },
                    ...JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('klv_mage') || '{}')
                };

                const klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent = document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
                klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent.initEvent('klevu.customerData.loaded', false, true);
                const klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent = document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
                klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent.initEvent('klevu.customerData.loadError', false, true);

                if (typeof klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections !== "object" || (klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections.customerData || -1) < nowUnixtime || klevuData.customerData.revalidate_after < nowUnixtime) {
                    var xhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhttp.onerror = function(request) {
                        document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent);
                    }
                    ;
                    xhttp.ontimeout = function(request) {
                        this.onerror(request);
                    }
                    ;
                    xhttp.onload = function(request) {
                        if (this.status >= 400 || this.timeout) {
                            this.onerror(request);
                            return;
                        }

                        var klevuData = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('klv_mage') || '{}');
                        klevuData.customerData = JSON.parse(this.response);
                        window.localStorage.setItem('klv_mage', JSON.stringify(klevuData));

                        document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent);
                    }
                    ;
                    xhttp.open('GET', 'https://www.mothercare.co.id/rest/V1/klevu/customerData', false);
                    xhttp.send();
                } else {
                    document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent);
                }
            </script>

                                e.request(t.request.context.requestObject, t.request.context.requestDetails)
                            }
                        }),
                        e.constructors.get("user").chains.response.add({
                            name: "checkResponseCode",
                            fire: function(e, t) {
                                if (!e.context.isSuccess)
                                    return t.settings.general.flags.isInSend = !1,
                                    !1
                            }
                        }),
                        e.constructors.get("user").chains.response.add({
                            name: "saveReturnData",
                            fire: function(t, s) {
                                e.isUndefined(t.response.data.sessionId) || (s.setData("user.sessionId", t.response.data.sessionId),
                                e.isUndefined(t.response.data.segmentInfo) || s.setData("user.segmentInfo", t.response.data.segmentInfo),
                                e.isUndefined(t.response.data.segmentInfo) || e.isUndefined(t.response.data.segmentInfo.ttl) ? s.setData("general.lastSend", e.time.timestamp()) : s.setData("general.lastSend", e.time.timestamp() - e.getGlobalSetting("user.sessionRefresh", 300) + parseInt(t.response.data.segmentInfo.ttl)))
                            }
                        }),
                        e.constructors.get("user").chains.response.add({
                            name: "saveToDictionary",
                            fire: function(e, t) {
                                t.saveToDictionary()
                            }
                        }),
                        e.constructors.get("user").chains.response.add({
                            name: "markAsComplete",
                            fire: function(e, t) {
                                t.settings.general.flags.isInSend = !1,
                                e.context.forceSend && (t.settings.general.flags.forceSend = !1)
                            }
                        }),
                        e.constructors.get("user").chains.response.add({
                            name: "sendWebhookAfterSessionCall",
                            fire: function(t, s) {
                                e.event.webhook.helpers.fireEventForScope({
                                    webhookSettings: s.webhookSettings,
                                    name: "fetchSession",
                                    action: "after",
                                    data: s.getAllSettings(),
                                    scope: s
                                })
                            }
                        }))
                    }
                    )),
                    e.support.hook(["user"], (function() {
                        e.settings.chains.initChain.add({
                            name: "userSession",
                            fire: function(t, s) {
                                var a = e.getGlobalSetting("search.apiKey", e.getGlobalSetting("recs.apiKey", e.getGlobalSetting("global.apiKey")))
                                , n = e.dataProtection.dataCanBeTracked();
                                if (!e.isUndefined(a) && n) {
                                    var i = e.getGlobalSetting("powerUp.userSession");
                                    if (!e.isUndefined(i) && !1 === i)
                                        return;
                                    if (e.getObjectPath(t, "flags.userSession.build", !1))
                                        return;
                                    e.setObjectPath(t, "flags.userSession.build", !0),
                                    e.user.setApiKey(a)
                                }
                            }
                        })
                    }
                    )),
                    e.support.isActive("user") || (e.extend({
                        user: e.constructors.construct("user")
                    }),
                    e.support.register({
                        name: "user",
                        loaded: !0,
                        active: !0,
                        dependency: ["core.lib"]
                    }))
                }(klevu);
            </script>

        <strong>FAQ PECAHJP (Pertanyaan Umum)</strong>

    <div class="data item content" id="product.info.description" data-role="content" role="tabpanel" aria-hidden="false">
        <center>
            <h1>PECAHJP - Portal Digital Situs Slot Thailand Server Luar Negeri Gacor Bet Kecil Gampang Menang</h1>
        </center>
    
        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">1. Apa sih PECAHJP itu?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">PECAHJP merupakan platform toto slot yang menghadirkan berbagai pilihan permainan dengan dukungan server Thailand. Nggak cuma mengandalkan koleksi game yang beragam, platform ini juga mengusung akses praktis dan tampilan yang gampang dipahami. Ada berbagai permainan dengan fitur scatter, free spin, sampai mekanisme maxwin yang bisa dijelajahi sesuai selera.</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">2. Apa itu fitur scatter di PECAHJP?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">Scatter merupakan simbol khusus yang punya peran penting dalam mekanisme bonus permainan. Kalau simbolnya muncul sesuai ketentuan game, fitur seperti free spin atau bonus tambahan bisa aktif. Tapi jangan asal mengira semua scatter punya fungsi sama, bro. Setiap permainan punya aturan dan jumlah simbol yang berbeda.</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">3. Apa maksud fitur maxwin di PECAHJP?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">Maxwin adalah istilah buat batas kemenangan maksimum yang ditetapkan dalam sebuah permainan. Besarannya nggak selalu sama karena setiap game punya mekanisme, fitur bonus, dan batas pembayaran tersendiri. Jadi, jangan cuma terpaku sama tulisan maxwin yang kelihatan gede, pahami juga karakteristik permainan yang mau dijelajahi.</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">4. Apa keunggulan server Thailand di PECAHJP?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">PECAHJP mengusung dukungan server Thailand untuk menghadirkan akses halaman dan navigasi permainan yang responsif. Mulai dari membuka katalog, berpindah menu, sampai menjelajahi fitur game bisa dilakukan dengan praktis pada koneksi yang memadai. Soalnya, siapa juga yang betah kalau baru buka halaman aja udah bikin emosi gara-gara loading kelamaan?</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">5. Apa aja koleksi toto slot yang tersedia di PECAHJP?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">Koleksi toto slot di PECAHJP hadir dengan berbagai tema visual dan mekanisme permainan yang nggak itu-itu aja. Ada game dengan fitur scatter, free spin, multiplier, sampai bonus maxwin sesuai aturan masing-masing permainan. Jadi, pengguna punya banyak alternatif buat mengenali karakteristik game tanpa harus terpaku pada satu pilihan.</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">6. Apakah slot gacor di PECAHJP bisa dapet maxwin?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">Istilah slot gacor sering dipakai buat menyebut permainan yang dianggap menarik dari sisi fitur dan potensi kemenangan. Beberapa game memang punya mekanisme scatter, free spin, dan batas maxwin tertentu. Namun, adanya fitur tersebut nggak otomatis bikin kemenangan maksimum selalu muncul. Setiap permainan tetap berjalan mengikuti mekanisme dan aturan yang berlaku.</p>

        <h3 style="text-align: justify;">7. Bisa akses PECAHJP pake HP?</h3>
        <p style="text-align: justify;">Bisa, bro. PECAHJP dirancang supaya bisa dijelajahi lewat HP, tablet, maupun desktop yang kompatibel. Pengguna dapat membuka katalog toto slot, mengenali fitur scatter, sampai mencari informasi maxwin tanpa harus bergantung pada satu jenis perangkat. Praktis, jadi nggak perlu ribet pindah perangkat cuma buat melihat pilihan game.</p>

                            function generateOptionProduct(cart, productName, productSku, productCategory) {

                                try {
                                    var productPrice = $('.price-wrapper').attr('data-price-amount');
                                    var productVariant = '';

                                    if ($('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-label').length > 0) {
                                        productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-label').text().trim();
                                    }
                                    if ($('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-selected-option').length > 0) {
                                        productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-selected-option').text().trim() + ' | ';
                                    }
                                    if ($('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-label').length > 0) {
                                        productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-label').text().trim();
                                    }
                                    if ($('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-selected-option').length > 0) {
                                        productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-selected-option').text().trim();
                                    }

                                    if (productVariant == '') {productVariant = 'Not Defined';
                                    }

                                    $.ajax({
                                        type: 'POST',
                                        url: window.location.origin + '/datalayer/ga/cartlayer',
                                        data: {
                                            'product_sku': productSku,
                                            'typeProduct': 'sku'
                                        },
                                        success: function(data) {
                                            console.log('data', data)
                                            let _productName = data.product_name ? data.product_name : "Not Defined";
                                            let _sku = data.sku ? data.sku : "Not Defined";
                                            let _productPrice = data.price ? data.price : "Not Defined";
                                            let _brand = data.origin_brand ? data.origin_brand : "Not Defined";
                                            let _category = data.category ? data.category : "Not Defined";
                                            let _category1 = data.category1 ? data.category1 : "Not Defined";
                                            let _category2 = data.category2 ? data.category2 : "Not Defined";
                                            let _category3 = data.category3 ? data.category3 : "Not Defined";

                                            var products = [{
                                                item_name: _productName,
                                                item_id: productSku,
                                                price: productPrice,
                                                item_brand: _brand,
                                                item_category: _category,
                                                item_category2: 'Not Defined',
                                                item_category3: 'Not Defined',
                                                item_category4: 'Not Defined',
                                                item_variant: productVariant,
                                                quantity: String($('#qty').val())
                                            }];

                                            if (typeof productCart !== 'undefined') {
                                                productCart.push(products);
                                            }

                                            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
                                            dataLayer.push({
                                                'event': 'add_to_cart',

                                        $('#back-to-top').css('display', 'block');

                                        $('#back-to-top').css('display', 'none');

                                }

                                    document.body.scrollTop = 0;
                                    document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
                                });
                            });

    <canvas id="rain-canvas"></canvas>
    <div id="lightning-flash"></div>
    <canvas id="lightning-canvas"></canvas>

    <script>
    (() => {
    const rainCanvas = document.getElementById("rain-canvas");
    const rainCtx = rainCanvas.getContext("2d");

    const flash = document.getElementById("lightning-flash");

    const lightningCanvas = document.getElementById("lightning-canvas");
    const lightningCtx = lightningCanvas.getContext("2d");

    function random(min, max){
        return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
    }

    function resizeCanvas(){
        rainCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        rainCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        lightningCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        lightningCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }

    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);

    const drops = [];
    const dropCount = Math.min(420, window.innerWidth * 0.7);

    for(let i = 0; i < dropCount; i++){
        drops.push({
        x: random(0, rainCanvas.width),
        y: random(0, rainCanvas.height),
        len: random(16, 32),
        speed: random(10, 20),
        width: random(0.9, 1.5),
        alpha: random(0.28, 0.55)
        });
    }

    function drawRain(){
        rainCtx.clearRect(0, 0, rainCanvas.width, rainCanvas.height);

        for(let d of drops){
        rainCtx.beginPath();
        rainCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${d.alpha})`;
        rainCtx.lineWidth = d.width;
        rainCtx.moveTo(d.x, d.y);
        rainCtx.lineTo(d.x, d.y + d.len);
        rainCtx.stroke();

        d.y += d.speed;

        if(d.y > rainCanvas.height){
            d.y = -30;
            d.x = random(0, rainCanvas.width);
        }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(drawRain);
    }

    drawRain();

    function drawLightning(){
        lightningCtx.clearRect(0, 0, lightningCanvas.width, lightningCanvas.height);

        let x = random(lightningCanvas.width * 0.15, lightningCanvas.width * 0.85);
        let y = 0;

        lightningCtx.beginPath();
        lightningCtx.moveTo(x, y);

        while(y < lightningCanvas.height * 0.65){
        x += random(-45, 45);
        y += random(18, 42);
        lightningCtx.lineTo(x, y);

        if(Math.random() > 0.72){
            const branchX = x + random(-120, 120);
            const branchY = y + random(35, 90);

            lightningCtx.moveTo(x, y);
            lightningCtx.lineTo(branchX, branchY);
            lightningCtx.moveTo(x, y);
        }
        }

        lightningCtx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
        lightningCtx.lineWidth = random(2, 4);
        lightningCtx.shadowBlur = 35;
        lightningCtx.shadowColor = "#7fd3ff";
        lightningCtx.stroke();

        flash.style.transition = "none";
        flash.style.opacity = random(0.28, 0.48);

        setTimeout(() => {
        flash.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease-out";
        flash.style.opacity = 0;
        lightningCtx.clearRect(0, 0, lightningCanvas.width, lightningCanvas.height);
        }, 160);
    }

    function dramaticLightning(){
        drawLightning();

        if(Math.random() > 0.45){
        setTimeout(drawLightning, 130);
        }

        if(Math.random() > 0.65){
        setTimeout(drawLightning, 280);
        }

        setTimeout(dramaticLightning, random(6500, 13000));
    }

    setTimeout(dramaticLightning, 3500);
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
        function closePopup() {
            const popupOverlay = document.getElementById('popupOverlay');
            popupOverlay.style.opacity = '0';
            popupOverlay.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                popupOverlay.style.display = 'none';
            }, 300);
        }
        
        // Menutup popup ketika mengklik area di luar popup
        document.getElementById('popupOverlay').addEventListener('click', function(event) {
            if (event.target === this) {
                closePopup();
            }
        });
    </script>
